messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

input.request: Password reset in our web app. The user says they forgot their password; the web app looks up their account in the user database; the app emails a one-time reset link through the email service; the user opens the link and the app lets them choose a new password, after which they are signed in.

assumptions: The email service is a third party outside our system, so it sits outside the zone.
The user database is part of our app's backend, so it sits in the same zone as the web app.
The user is signed in once the new password is saved, so the final step is shown as the app returning the user signed in.
The user opens the link in the same web app, so the link leads back to the app rather than to a separate page.

reply.text:
I've drafted the graph: the user, the web app and user database inside your app's backend, and the external email service. The flow runs from the forgotten-password request, through the account lookup and the emailed one-time link, to the new password and sign-in.

I assumed the email service is third-party, so it sits outside your backend, and that the user is signed in once the new password is saved. Does the graph look right?
